title: Build Generic Scrim Intake V1
objective: Create a generic, safe, deterministic and local intake foundation that validates a new scrim bundle and stops at READY_FOR_FACTUAL_PROCESSING.
module: Continuous Review / Generic Scrim Intake V1
moduleGoal: Separate accepted historical targets 001-004 from a reusable continuous-review intake namespace for new targets 009-999 without connecting downstream processing or product routes.
observableOutcome: A local operator can dry-run or atomically register one validated replay plus one validated MP4 and optional unprocessed Craig tracks under a stable review target, with deterministic identity, idempotency and conflict protection.
metricContribution: Namespace 009-999, two required input slots, optional arbitrary-positive Craig tracks, deterministic fingerprints, atomic local registration, zero real match registration, zero protected access, parsing, ASR, synchronization, copying or product mutation.
remainingModuleGap: No factual telemetry, Replay-VOD/Craig synchronization, candidates, visual evidence, workspace/library registration, metadata editor or cover selection is connected.
hardeningDeferred: No storage/import layer, upload, browser UI, cloud integration, authentication, automatic metadata, cover selection, gameplay analysis, ASR or downstream orchestration.

executionContract.reasoningComplexity: High: validate large local media safely and deterministically while rejecting protected aliases before filesystem access and preserving all accepted MVP cardinalities and privacy boundaries.
executionContract.objective: Deliver Generic Scrim Intake V1 as the first bounded unit of the AlphaVeil Continuous Review Pipeline.
technicalContext: Task 217 is externally accepted at the exact base under alphaveil_mvp_showcase_polish_ready; 001-004 remain accepted historical targets and 005-008 remain reserved/protected.
confirmedState: Clean main and origin/main at 16b0d69499e92ba676495de961d575db8cfdd068; Task 219 absent; no new real scrim supplied.
branchEnvironment: Windows PowerShell, npm.cmd, main, exactly one normal pushed commit, no amend or force.
allowedScope: New tools/continuous-review module, local manifest schema, synthetic/temp tests and canary, npm review:intake command, compact capability evidence and coordination/report artifacts.
protectedAreas: No filesystem access to replay/review aliases 005-008, packages, accepted historical intake artifacts, Product/Review/Replay models or routes, real media copying/versioning, parser, ASR, synchronization, candidates, frames or Task 219.
expectedChanges: Target/path guards, bounded Source 2 header and MP4 probes, streaming hashes, optional Craig inventory, deterministic manifest/fingerprints, dry-run, atomic register, idempotency/conflict detection, CLI help and synthetic functional canary.
acceptanceCriteria: Targets 009-999 validate while 001-004 are legacy and 005-008 reject before filesystem; required replay/video and optional Craig contracts pass all negative and positive tests.

Dry-run writes nothing; register atomically publishes a schema-valid deterministic local manifest; repeated/same, conflicting and duplicate-bundle registration outcomes are correct with no media copy.
The accepted MVP remains exactly 4 targets, 207 moments, 102 legacy candidates, 48/57 Replay markers, 11 review fields, 15 error classes and 9 tracks.
mandatoryTests: Generic intake unit/security/schema/canary tests; Task217 showcase, Product View Model, Review Presentation, Scrim Presentation, Review Workspace and Scrim Player regressions; coordination, task queue, lint and output-size checks.
requiredEvidence: Local isolated canary evidence, compact summary/gate, complete report and structural post-commit attestation; no real intake manifest or media artifact.
commitPolicy: Exactly one commit: Build generic scrim intake foundation; explicit staging; normal push main; no amend or force.
stopConditions: Base divergence, protected alias filesystem access, real scrim registration, replay parsing, ASR/synchronization/downstream execution, product target mutation, media staging, historical regression or Task 219.
returnReportFormat: Resultado; O que passou a funcionar; Target namespace; Input integrity; Communication intake; Functional canary; Existing MVP regression; Segurança e privacidade; Limitações; Git; Gate; Milestone; Próximo objetivo.

stopConditions: No Task 219, protected access, real match registration, media versioning/copy, replay parsing, ASR, synchronization, candidate/frame generation, product/library mutation or accepted historical artifact rewrite.
